Mark the student's response to a question from Riverview Task 1 2024 (a Riverview Year 12 Business Studies assessment, Operations topic) strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 13(a) [3 marks]: Discuss the balance between cost and quality for this business.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Jiminy's Cricket Company (JCC) manufactures high quality cricket gear. In order to improve profitability materials will now be sourced from the global market.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 3):
3 marks: Provides comprehensive discussion of the balance of cost and quality for this business
2 marks: Provides a discussion of the balance of cost and quality
1 marks: Makes a statement about cost and quality

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
The balance of cost and quality for JCC refers to the relationship between the quality of the cricket products they produce and the costs associated with making such high quality equipment. Generally, quality goes up or down in line with production costs. Higher quality cricket equipment needs higher quality inputs and greater detail in making them, which increases expenses. JCC need a balance that makes their products high quality but not so expensive that customers will not buy them. Similarly, they do not want to decrease costs by purchasing lesser quality inputs and then see the quality of the output decrease.


TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Students need to discuss the balance of cost and quality. Many fell into the 1 to 2 mark range because they only provided statements about the relationship without enough depth.
